Visit note | 2026-03-30 09:30 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Karim Majumder, 47, male. Mr. Majumder returns for review reporting ongoing cramping belly pain and bloating that has been worse since starting a high-pressure job in Barishal. He is an architect who works long hours and eats irregular meals. He reports no fever, blood in stool, or unintended weight loss, and denies other bowel complaints. Examination reveals soft abdomen with tenderness in the lower quadrants and no masses. Vital signs show pain score 4/10, BP 117/73 mmHg, pulse 90 bpm, and weight 85 kg. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. Advice provided: eat regular meals; keep a food diary; reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2026-03-30 09:30 AM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Laila Matubbar, 62, female.
